name: sitebases_project
description: Container repository for sitebase, cookebannersystem, and aihubproject submodules

scripts.build:cookebanner: npm --prefix cookebannersystem/backend run package:sharedhost-zip && node scripts/open-folder.js cookebannersystem/backend/sharedhost-release
scripts.build:cookebanner:backend: npm --prefix cookebannersystem/backend run build && node scripts/open-folder.js cookebannersystem/backend/dist
scripts.build:cookebanner:frontend: npm --prefix cookebannersystem/frontend run build && node scripts/open-folder.js cookebannersystem/frontend/dist
